correctness.rationale: Verified determinant definition d(U)=4! volume. The polynomial is separately degree at most five in each bias and vanishes when that bias is zero or one, giving a factor q_i. Cube reflections and coordinate permutation force a symmetric multiaffine quotient in q_i. A full exact enumeration of 4368 unordered five-subsets, cross-checked with two integer determinant algorithms, yields the 13 Hamming-total coefficients and checks all polynomial coefficients of P(p,p,p,p)=q^4(1-16q^3+18q^4). This uniquely determines the full quotient 1-4e3(q)+18e4(q). Positivity and the sharp 46 coefficient follow from q_i<=1/4 and equality at q_i=1/4; an exact unequal-bias regression supplements but does not replace the proof.

value.rationale: Independent-coordinate Bernoulli cube weights are canonically motivated by product probability measures and random determinants, not an arbitrary finite parameter slice. The result gives a complete exact four-parameter evaluation in the first unresolved cube dimension, identifies previously opaque three-way and four-way variance coefficients, and establishes an optimal quantitative deficit for a natural four-dimensional combinatorial convex-geometric polynomial. It answers neither the unrestricted hypercube conjecture nor an arbitrary moment problem; its exact fixed-dimensional content remains substantively motivated.
